L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP fuses at least two distinct upstream signals — the token embedding at its position and the L0 attention output — into one non-binary output; baseline run r2 shows the same token at different positions produces writes varying by up to 24 units (position/attention context alters output), and ablating all L0 attention heads (r4) shifts L0_MLP writes by 355–385 units, confirming attention is a distinct second source; ablating L0_MLP itself (r7) collapses both all-7s and all-3s inputs to the same wrong prediction, confirming it is the primary computation.
